name: Black Sumac
desc: Black Sumac (Rhus copallina): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 20 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rhus copallinum, the winged sumac, shining sumac, dwarf sumac or flameleaf sumac, is a species of flowering plant in the cashew family (Anacardiaceae) that is native to eastern North America.
